steps.en: Resigned staff list is refreshed every evening.
steps.id: Daftar staff resign di-refresh tiap malam.
steps.why_en: Nothing in the code refreshes this list; it is probably done by another system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada kode yang me-refresh daftar ini; kemungkinan dikerjakan sistem lain.

steps.en: A daily job starts at 8:30 PM.
steps.why_en: The job is set for 8:30 PM, but the real clock time is not proven from the code.
steps.why_id: Job diatur jam 20:30, tapi jam sebenarnya tidak terbukti dari kode.

steps.en: The job reads resigned staff and finds matching ACM users.
steps.id: Job membaca staff resign dan mencari user ACM yang cocok.

steps.en: The matching user's role assignments are removed.
steps.id: Role milik user yang cocok dihapus.

steps.en: The user is set to inactive, not deleted.
